_about: Photo pool for the Naira Shop All campaign (4 Nov 2026). Every photo is an existing, already-approved Naira photo; no new photos may be generated. Prices and stock read from Shopify on 4 Nov 2026. 'proof' is the Meta result of the ad that used this photo or its direct predecessor. heroes/ are full scenes without text; worn/ are the store's own on-model listing photos (same model, mustard slip, warm beige ground) that the two best-converting catalogue carousels were built on.

heroes.proof: 'Almost edible.' 6.21% CTR Story, 5.61% Feed; 10 sales at 1.67x, the account's best-selling concept ad
